attempts.error: pwm_output requires a PWM capable pin for arduino:avr:uno and numeric type

Unsupported hardware: ["Pwm_output requires a PWM-capable pin on arduino:avr:uno. D2 and D4 are not in the confirmed Uno PWM set [3,5,6,9,10,11] but the circuit wiring requires R->D4 and B->D2. This cannot be implemented as pwm_output on this board without changing wiring or using a non-PWM output operation, which is prohibited here."]

Unsupported hardware: ["Original contract used pwm_output on D4 (Red) and D2 (Blue) and requires PWM-capable pins on arduino:avr:uno. Provided confirmed PWM pin set is [3,5,6,9,10,11], so pwm_output on D2 and D4 is unsupported without changing wiring or replacing the output operation (prohibited)."]
